text:
leo: heads-up — after the 02:00 OOB BMC refresh in us-west2 we started seeing jump-host serial queues spike and a few consoles failing handoff. GPU provisioning latency climbed, scheduler retries increasing. anyone seeing matching alerts?

mira: seeing it — jumpd metrics: session_queue_length > 800 for jump-hosts in rack-usw2-3. some sessions stuck in a SECBOOT_PROBE state.

deploy-bot: [deploy] oob-firmware-job finished on rack-usw2-3; firmware image signed v1.5.0 applied to 12/12 BMCs, rc=0.

arjun: provisioning churn from the scheduler — many `Pod` create -> backoff -> retry. embeddings and GPU inference jobs got preempted. we lost ~6 GPUs worth of capacity while the consoles flapped.

kathy: if secure boot probe is blocking serial handoff can we temporarily set secure boot permissive on those racks? compliance caveats for some customers though.

sam: I can route new GPU allocation requests away from the impacted racks to eu1 and us-central for the next 90m. cost heads-up: cross-region shifts will add egress and may hit reserved capacity. want me to do it?

leo: yes, please redirect allocations. also pause the rest of the BMC rollout immediately. we'll run a canary rollback on 2 hosts first.

mira: a quick signal: `journalctl -u jumpd | grep -E "session_queue|SECBOOT_PROBE"` shows repeated probe logs and `kvm-pty: open: resource temporarily unavailable`.

arjun: short workaround: on the jump-hosts set `jumpd.max_sessions=200` and restart `systemctl restart jumpd` to shed queued sessions while we triage — reduces head-of-line blocking.

leo: agree on the restart. plan: 1) pause rollout 2) throttle new oob jobs 3) canary rollback to v1.4.7 on 2 nodes 4) route new GPU requests off impacted racks 5) open incident ticket and runbook.

kathy: cost/impact: routing to eu1 + fallback to preemptible GPUs will increase unit cost ~15-20% for affected jobs. flagging to finance/pm.

deploy-bot: created incident #7891: "jump-host serial queueing after BMC v1.5.0 rollout (us-west2)". runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oob-serial-queue

mira: noticed TPM cert rotation events clustered with the rollout window — HSM logs show `rotate_requested=true` for the rack. might be a cert handshake that trips the secureboot probe on serial path. investigating.

arjun: if TPM rotation is the root, skipping the serial-secureboot probe for console handoff (for non-attested nodes) could be a low-risk mitigation until we patch BMC. crafting a small jumpd patch to ignore `SECBOOT_PROBE` on pty paths.

leo: deploy the jumpd patch to 1 jump-host canary, confirm console handoffs recover, then roll to the rest. coordinate with oncall and security for the temporary attestation change.

mira: patch pushed to canary, restarting jumpd now. will report back in 5m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: reroute applied — schedulers are now allocating new GPU pods to eu1/us-central. watching for spillback.

leo: thanks. once we confirm canary stable we'll either rollback BMC or ask vendor for an urgent hotfix. keep the incident updated.
